skill.name: kleros-ipfs-upload
skill.description: Uploads Kleros dispute evidence, meta-evidence, policies, and justifications to IPFS through an x402 gateway using Base USDC payment.
skill.summary: Pay for Kleros IPFS uploads and return usable CIDs and gateway URLs.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are lexical false positives caused by Markdown backticks, TypeScript template literals, documented URLs, and expected credential variables. Confirmed risks include shell-visible secret examples and private-key generation to standard output. Semantic review also found unrestricted paid gateway overrides, public upload of arbitrary local files, and unpinned wallet-authorized dependencies.

remediation.issue: Paid requests can be redirected or challenged with unexpected terms.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist the Kleros host and validate chain, token, payee, and a strict maximum amount before any wallet signature.

remediation.issue: Any readable path can be uploaded to public IPFS without a safety gate.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation showing the resolved path, public permanence, destination, operation, and maximum charge before reading or uploading bytes.

remediation.issue: Documentation exposes private keys and CDP secrets through shell-oriented workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Use a secret manager or protected credential file, document restrictive permissions, and remove commands that print private keys or place secrets in history.

remediation.issue: Wallet-authorized dependencies are installed from mutable version ranges.
remediation.suggestion: Commit a reviewed lockfile, pin exact dependency versions, verify package integrity, and update only through a controlled security review.

content.value_statement: Kleros contributors need durable IPFS references for evidence and policy files. This skill prepares a paid x402 upload and returns the CID and Kleros gateway URL.
actual_capabilities: Uploads one local file through the bundled raw-key script.
Uploads one local file using a Coinbase CDP server account.
Selects an operation tag such as evidence, meta-evidence, or justification.
Runs free health, discovery, and unpaid payment-challenge checks.
Returns IPFS CIDs, Kleros gateway URLs, status details, and CID consistency warnings.
limitations: Each successful upload costs 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.
The gateway rejects requests above 4 MiB, including multipart overhead.
Uploaded content becomes publicly retrievable and may be difficult to remove.
Pinning availability depends on the Kleros gateway and its upstream services.

use_cases.title: Submit Dispute Evidence
use_cases.description: Upload a screenshot or document and receive a CID suitable for a Kleros dispute submission.

use_cases.title: Publish Court Policies
use_cases.description: Pin meta-evidence or policy files that courts and arbitrators reference from contracts or subgraphs.

use_cases.title: Validate Agent Uploads
use_cases.description: Check gateway health, payment enforcement, pinning, and CDN retrieval before integrating an automated workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Upload Dispute Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file path] as Kleros dispute evidence. Confirm the fee and public availability before any paid request.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a CID for one evidence file.

prompt_templates.title: Upload Meta-Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload [file path] with the meta-evidence operation. Return the CID, the Kleros gateway URL, and any consistency warning.
prompt_templates.scenario: A court operator is publishing a policy file.

prompt_templates.title: Run Free Pre-Flight Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the Kleros IPFS gateway health, discovery configuration, and unpaid payment challenge. Do not make a paid upload.
prompt_templates.scenario: A user wants current service validation without spending USDC.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a CDP Upload Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Coinbase CDP upload setup for [file path]. Verify destination, payment limits, credential handling, and retrieval before executing one approved test.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced developer is validating a hosted-agent integration.

output_examples.input: Upload exhibit-a.png as Kleros dispute evidence.
Check the gateway without spending USDC.
output: Discovery reported Base mainnet payment terms.
The unpaid request returned the expected payment challenge.
No CID consistency warning was reported.

best_practices: Review the exact file path and confirm that public publication is intended.
Run the free pre-flight checks before any paid upload.
Use a dedicated low-balance wallet and keep credentials outside shell history.
anti_patterns: Do not upload confidential, personal, or unrelated files to public IPFS.
Do not override the gateway URL unless payment terms and destination are independently verified.
Do not repeat paid smoke tests after one successful end-to-end result.

faq.question: Does every upload cost money?
faq.answer: Yes. Each successful upload costs 0.01 USDC on Base mainnet.

faq.question: Do I need ETH for gas?
faq.answer: The documented x402 flow states that the facilitator sponsors gas. The payer wallet still needs sufficient Base USDC.

faq.question: Which credentials can the scripts use?
faq.answer: Use either an EVM private key or Coinbase CDP server-account credentials. Keep all credentials in protected secret storage.

faq.question: Can the bundled scripts upload multiple files?
faq.answer: Each bundled script accepts one path per run. The documented HTTP API supports multiple file parts in one request.

faq.question: Can I remove an uploaded file?
faq.answer: Do not assume removal is possible. IPFS content may remain available through other pins or caches after publication.

faq.question: Should I use this for generic IPFS storage?
faq.answer: No. Use this gateway for Kleros-related artifacts or explicit gateway testing, and choose a general pinning service for unrelated content.
